Episodes.Description: Hanamichi Sakuragi is depressed after being rejected by 50 girls during middle school. Once he enters high school, he meets a girl (Haruko Akagi) who introduces him to basketball.

Episodes.Title: Go to Hell, Basketball! Hanamichi vs. Rukawa
Episodes.Description: After school, Hanamichi has a run-in with Rukawa Kaede, who Haruko has a crush on. Hanamichi gets into a fight with him out of jealousy, causing Haruko to hate him. Later, Hanamichi gets into a competition with the Shohoku basketball captain after he calls the sport 'childish'.

Episodes.Title: Gorilla vs. Hanamichi! Big Showdown!!
Episodes.Description: Hanamichi pulls off an amazing defense and manages to steal the ball from Akagi. He also manages to successfully pull off a slam dunk against Akagi. After the challenge, he finds out that Akagi is actually Haruko's brother.

Episodes.Title: Basketball Player Hanamichi Joins the Team!
Episodes.Description: Hanamichi decides to join the basketball club, which Akagi is against. Sakuragi tries to find a way to get on Akagi's good side for Haruko's sake. After Hanamichi shows his determination, Akagi lets him join the team and entrusts his basic training to the manager, Ayako.

Episodes.Title: A Spiritless Afternoon
Episodes.Description: Hanamichi is tired of being made to do basic dribbling practice by himself. After Akagi refuses to let him practice with the rest of the team, Hanamichi gets into a fight with him and quits the club. He later regrets his actions and returns to the club.

Episodes.Title: Rukawa vs. Akagi: The Real Showdown
Episodes.Description: Kogure remarks that Hanamichi is improving at an astonishing rate. Coach Anzai stops by to announce that they will be having a practice match against Ryonan High School soon. Anzai sets up a match, freshmen vs. seniors, to measure the freshmen's skills, but Akagi doesn't let Hanamichi play. Rukawa pulls off some great moves, but isn't able to score against Akagi.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi Debut! Dunk Explosion
Episodes.Description: After Rukawa is defeated by Akagi, he reveals his true potential and makes a spectacular dunk. Hanamichi is allowed to play for the last two minutes of the game, and he demonstrates his skill at dribbling that he learned from Ayako. He refuses to cooperate with his teammate Rukawa, however and tries to make a slam dunk, but end up smashing the ball into Akagi's head instead.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi's Crisis! The Judo-man's Trap
Episodes.Description: Aota Tatsuhiko, captain of the Shohoku Judo Club and a childhood friend of Akagi and Haruko, decides that he wants Hanamichi in the Judo Club because of his innate talent. He tries to use pictures of Haruko as bait to lure Hanamichi into the Judo Club.

Episodes.Title: I'm Going to Play Basketball
Episodes.Description: Aota continues to try and bribe Hanamichi into joining the Judo Club using Haruko's photos. Hanamichi decides that he will take the pictures, but not join the Judo Club. The two get into a fight, and Hanamichi declares that he will not join the Judo Club as he is a basketball player.

Episodes.Title: The Commoner's Shoot is Difficult
Episodes.Description: Akagi decides that it's about time that Hanamichi learns how to shoot. He asks Rukawa to demonstrate a simple layup shot, but Hanamichi isn't interested in learning from Rukawa. Inevitably, they get in a fight, and are banned from practice for the day.

Episodes.Title: Our Love's Special Secret Training
Episodes.Description: After practicing the lay up shot with Haruko before school, Hanamichi finally makes it in. After a bit more practice late after school, he figures that he can make the shot roughly one in three times. A player from Ryonan named Hikouichi comes to investigate Shohoku while Hanamichi is attempting a dunk, mistaking him for Rukawa after admiring his jumping ability.

Episodes.Title: Defeat Ryonan! The Fierce Training the Night Before the Match
Episodes.Description: The team practices for the upcoming match. Akagi stays after with Hanamichi the day before the match to instruct him on rebounds.

Episodes.Title: Shohoku vs Ryonan. Burning Captain!
Episodes.Description: The faceoff between Shohoku and Ryonan begins. Hanamichi is crushed when it is revealed that he won't be in the starting lineup, but soon relaxes when Anzai reassures him that he will become their 'secret weapon'. Uozomi and Akagi begin their rivalry as captains.

Episodes.Title: Super Basketball Match With Ryonan
Episodes.Description: The match starts off with Ryonan leading 19-0. Life returns to Shohoku after Rukawa gets the rebound and faces off with Sendo, passing the ball to Akagi for the dunk. Shohoku manages to catch up, ending the first half with a score of 42 to 50.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi Nervously Steps Into the Spotlight
Episodes.Description: Finally, Sakuragi gets a chance to play when Akagi injures himself while playing. Now, there is only about 9 minutes left on the clock.

Episodes.Title: Who is This Guy? Taoka's Miscalculation
Episodes.Description: With just 8 minutes left in the second half, Ryonan is still leading. Taoka tells the Ryonan to continue to attack. Sakuragi plays whole-heartedly and this impresses Sendoh.

Episodes.Title: The Rebound King Sakuragi Hanamichi's Distress
Episodes.Description: Ryonan is leading with 3 points ahead of Shohoku, and Taoka says that the game will depend on how Sakuragi plays. Meanwhile, Sakuragi begins to realize how important rebounds are.

Episodes.Title: Last 2 Minutes! I'll Be the One to Defeat Sendoh
Episodes.Description: Sendoh is amazed at how good Shohoku has become, thus he begins to take the game seriously. Anzai then calls both Rukawa and Sakuragi to approach, to tell them of his plan.

Episodes.Title: Time's Up! The Decisive Battle with Ryonan
Episodes.Description: Although Shohoku has lost the game, Sakuragi played very well for his first game. Sakuragi and Rukawa vow that in their next game with Ryonan, they will beat Sendoh.

Episodes.Title: Basketball Shoes
Episodes.Description: The next day, Haruko has to accompany Sakuragi to the sports shop to buy a new pair of shoes because his old shoes are in bad shape after the practice game with Ryonan.

Episodes.Title: Enormous Trouble Makers! Hanamichi vs Miyagi
Episodes.Description: Ryota Miyagi returns to basketball after being injured in a fight. Meanwhile, Ayako hears rumors of Miyagi's return, so she decides to investigate. She brings along Sakuragi, but Miyagi, who has a crush on Ayako, thinks that she and Sakuragi are together and immediately becomes jealous. Will Miyagi and Sakuragi be able to coexist?

Episodes.Title: History's Biggest Idiot Combination is Born
Episodes.Description: It almost seemed like Miyagi and Sakuragi were about to collide with each other, but it seems that things have turned out much better than expected.

Episodes.Title: Shohoku Basketball Club's Last Day
Episodes.Description: A former member of the Shohoku team returns with a major bone to pick. Does this spell doom for the team?

Episodes.Title: The Battle for Justice! Sakuragi's Goon Squad Joins!
Episodes.Description: After Ayako is slapped by one of the delinquents, Miyagi joins in the fight, and Rukawa follows suit. However, they are both easily taken down by Tetsuo. Sakuragi steps up, though he is outnumbered. Things change, however, when Sakuragi's friends appear in an unlikely fashion.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Aimed at National Championship
Episodes.Description: Mitsui and Tetsuo were defeated, but Mitsui still continues to fight. When Akagi arrives, the atmosphere becomes tense. Akagi slaps Mitsui around when the latter attacks him. Kogure then informs everyone that Mitsui was once an excellent basketball player, and was even on the team. Kogure then proceeds to tell the story of the rise and downfall of Mitsui's basketball career.

Episodes.Title: Mitsui, the Problems of the Past
Episodes.Description: It seems that Mitsui was once a great basketball player himself before high school. However, something happened during one practice session that changed everything.

Episodes.Title: I Want To Play Basketball!
Episodes.Description: After suffering through a severe injury, Mitsui quit basketball. Now two years later, in his attempt to sabotage Shohoku's chances of participating in the tournament, his feelings for the sport appear to be returning once again.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of Interhigh Preliminaries
Episodes.Description: The day of the tournament is quickly approaching. Sakuragi is anxious to play against Sendo again, but Shohoku will have to deal with Miuradai first.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi! Debut at an Official Game
Episodes.Description: The match starts, and Anzai refuses to put Sakuragi, Rukawa, Mitsui, and Miyagi in the starting line-up as punishment for fighting. Will Anzai keep it like this for the entire game?

Episodes.Title: The Introspective Army's Big Counterattack
Episodes.Description: With four of Shohoku's best players finally entering in the game, the tables turn quickly as they narrow the lead down to only 2. Sakuragi was hacked on a play, giving him two shots at the freethrow line, but things began to get tough for him, as nervousness broke his concentration, and his imagination started running wild.

Episodes.Title: Formidable Enemy Miuradai's Secret Weapon
Episodes.Description: Miuradai revealed a secret weapon of theirs that will help them try and overcome Shohoku, that secret weapon being the ox Nato.

Episodes.Title: Genius Hanamichi! Certain Death Dunk
Episodes.Description: Miuradai starts to gain control of the game, until Nato begins to block Rukawa instead of Sakuragi. Rukawa exploits his weakness, and this causes the game to go in Shohoku's favor.

Episodes.Title: Walkout King!? Hanamichi Sakuragi
Episodes.Description: Shohoku's next match is against Gohoku. While they have been exceeding almost everyone's expectations, Sakuragi continues to be laughed at for his nonsensical and pointless fouls. He starts to realize that he might not be so great after all.

Episodes.Title: Gorilla's Secret, Kill with Your Eyes!
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi and his fouling troubles continue. He unconsciously went to Akagi's house for help, and in order to help Sakuragi a little bit, Akagi gives him one piece of advice... instill his opponents with fear using his eyes. Sakuragi takes this too literally, with predictable results.

Episodes.Title: Hot Blooded Guys
Episodes.Description: Mitsui got himself caught up in a fight between Ryo and Tetsuo, and was eventually beaten himself. However, Sakuragi pops out of nowhere, and comes to aid his teammate when trying to get to the gym.

Episodes.Title: A Well Seeded School, Enter Shoyo
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi is still upset at Akagi for telling him a false technique in defense, and tries harder the next game against Tsukubu. While he gets fouled out, he's improving rather quickly, and he'll need it against a powerhouse team like Shoyo, who's the second ranking team in the tournament.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi: First-time As Starter!
Episodes.Description: Anzai-sensei decides to start Sakuragi, much to everyone's shock. He figures that with his height and drive, he'll be the perfect weapon to use against Shoyo.

Episodes.Title: Rukawa's Counterattack!
Episodes.Description: With the Shohoku offense stalled by Shoyo's defense, Rukawa takes it upon himself to lead the offensive charge.

Episodes.Title: Lightning Flash Ryota!
Episodes.Description: With Rukawa taking the heat off of the rest of the team, Miyagi gets a chance to show off his skills as a point guard and his speed on the court.

Episodes.Title: Rebound King Hanamichi Sakuragi!
Episodes.Description: With Mitsui's 3 point shot, Shohoku finally catches up with Shoyo. It seems like Fujima has had enough, but Hanagata asks him to trust him for a little while longer. Fujima made a good decision in trusting his star center, for Shoyo pulled away from Shohoku again, creating another 10 point deficit.

Episodes.Title: Shoyo's Ace Fujima Enters the Court
Episodes.Description: Driven hard by Rukawa's offense and Sakuragi's rebounding, Fujima comes off the bench to lead his team to victory.

Episodes.Title: Shoyo Ace Fujima's Real Ability
Episodes.Description: Fujima is leading a strong charge for Shoyo against Shohoku, taking the lead once again. Though Shohoku has other problems besides Fujima; Mitsui is already very tired. Will Kogure be able to take his place?

Episodes.Title: Has Mitsui Reached His Limit!?
Episodes.Description: Shohoku's problems continue piling up. Mitsui can't get a 3 pointer to go in, forcing all the burden on Rukawa. Plus, Sakuragi is on the brink of fouling out, one more and he's gone. Is this the end for Shohoku?

Episodes.Title: Mitsui! Stormy 3 Points
Episodes.Description: Mitsui, reminiscing upon the past, gets the energy to play and lead his team. In just a matter of time, he scores 9 consecutive points thanks to his impressive shooting, but is it enough to overcome Shoyo?

Episodes.Title: Imminent Walkout!? Hanamichi's Pinch
Episodes.Description: While Mitsui has increased his efficiency during the game, Sakuragi still faces the risk of being dismissed. After a few destructive words from Rukawa, Sakuragi is fueled with fire.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi, Hot Dunk
Episodes.Description: Thanks to a basket from Rukawa, Shohoku has finally taken the lead in a critical time. Sakuragi, wanting to feel important, jumps up at the same time as two opposing Shoyo players as he goes for the dunk. It seems like Sakuragi's long desire to perform a slam dunk will be fulfilled.

Episodes.Title: Challenge From a Rival
Episodes.Description: Shohoku has defeated Shoyo, and Sakuragi is quick to spread the word, especially after his ferocious slam dunk on Hanagata. It seems like Oda, a person that went to the same junior high as him, is going to be facing Kainan. They're also hoping to pull off an upset victory like Shohoku has.

Episodes.Title: The Guy Who Pledged to Defeat Kainan
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi skips practice in order to investigate on why Yohko was acting so strangely. When they get to Takezono, he is immediately met by hordes of girls who misjudge his delinquent looks as someone who came to beat up Oda in order to Sabotage Takezono's chances of beating Kainan.

Episodes.Title: Takezono, Last Fight
Episodes.Description: The match between Takezono and Kainan starts. Kainan only put in two starters the entire game, but it seemed like it was enough to take care of their opponents. That wasn't Takezono's only problem; Oda's injury remains ignorant to everyone but Yohko and Sakuragi, and it's clearly affecting his ability to play.

Episodes.Title: Outside Calculation!? Hanamichi at His Best!
Episodes.Description: The match between Shohoku and Kainan has been tight and intense all the way through, but it was Sakuragi who stood out the most with his cocky attitude and amazing athleticism. However, Kainan's coach is planning something to get Sakuragi off the court.

Episodes.Title: Secret Weapon Against Sakuragi!
Episodes.Description: Takato seemed to have devised the perfect plan to counter-attack against Sakuragi, which is sending in the extremely small and weak Miyamasu. In an unbelievable turn around, the plan worked in which Sakuragi ends up horribly embarrassed, allowing Kainan to widen the gap. Rukawa however, seems to be heating up.

Episodes.Title: The Gorilla's Injury! Desperate Situation!?
Episodes.Description: Coach Anzai asks for a time-out and substitutes Sakuragi. Rukawa is heated-up and starts scoring for Shohoku. Akagi assists with rebounds but takes a misstep and injures his foot. As he has to be taken out, Sakuragi goes back into the court with some words from Ansai for him and Rukawa. In the meantime, Ryonan is winning with an overwhelming difference against Takesato.

Episodes.Title: The Guy Who Dominates the Game
Shohoku on the Edge
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi blames himself deeply for Shohoku's loss against Kainan and becomes depressed. However, after a beating match against Rukawa, who tries to leviate the blame on himself, Sakuragi shaves his red head bald. This episode also introduces Kicchou Fukuda, a player on Ryonan's basketball team that was in disgrace.

Episodes.Title: Battle of the Aces! Kainan vs Ryonan
The Strongest Match! Sendoh vs Maki
The Final Battle! Shohoku vs Ryonan
The Greatest Shame of One's Life
Rukawa Kaede, Gambling on the 2nd Half
Vice-Captain Kogure's Determination
Episodes.Description: While shooting a three-pointer that will determine Shohoku's chances of winning, Kogure has a flashback from his early days of playing basketball up to the present, which also counts as a recap of the series from Kogure's point of view.

Episodes.Title: Win or Lose
Episodes.Description: It is a race against time between Shohoku and Ryonan to win the basketball match and earn the final qualifying position for the National Championship Games.

Episodes.Title: New Challenge: The National Championship!
Episodes.Description: The Shohoku Basketball Team's reputation has grown popular following their winning the final qualifying position for the National Championship Games, with Rukawa's popularity soaring high, much to Sakuragi's ire. However, it seems that Rukawa has some high ambitions of his own.

Episodes.Title: Rukawa's Ambition
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of Ryonan losing the final qualifying position for the National Championship Games, Uozomi and Ikegami retire from the basketball team, passing the team's leadership to Sendoh, whom Yayoi Aida, Hikoichi's older sister and a basketball magazine reporter, wants to do a report on despite her editor's refusal on the grounds that Ryonan had lost.

Episodes.Title: Japan's Number One High School Player
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi chances upon Kainan players Maki and Kiyota and accompanies them to watch a basketball match between Sannoh Industry Affiliated High School and Aiwa Academy, which Maki acknowledges will be the new powerful rivals Shohoku will face in the National Championship Games. Meanwhile, Rukawa visits Coach Anzai to ask for his blessing for his wish to study abroad in the United States of America. To his surprise, Coach Anzai refuses, instead telling him to become the top-ranking player in Japan before he even thought of it.

Episodes.Title: The Basketball Kingdom - America
Episodes.Description: Coach Anzai's wife tells Rukawa the story of Ryuji Yazawa, a talented basketball player from Anzai's past 10 years ago who became dissatisfied with Anzai's tough training for him alone and left Japan to play in the United States, where he thought he would have better opportunities to show his talent, only to become depressed as a result of the unsupportive American college basketball culture and die in a high-speed head-on car collision five years later, reportedly under the influence of drugs. This revelation forces Rukawa to rethink his views on basketball playing.

Episodes.Title: Rukawa Kaede's Spirit
Episodes.Description: With a new viewpoint, Rukawa shows great improvement on his basketball skills, impressing his teammates and fans alike, much to the ire of Sakuragi. Haruko also comes to realize that her crush on Rukawa will never be requited.

Episodes.Title: Shohoku's Real Ace
Episodes.Description: Unwilling to accept Rukawa's improvement, Sakuragi challenges his rival to a one-on-one match to see who befits the role of Shohoku's Ace player. Meanwhile, Akagi is visited by the coach and captain of Shintai University's basketball team at his house with the invitation of joining their team upon graduating high school.

Episodes.Title: The Nationals' Crisis!
Episodes.Description: The Shohoku Basketball Team faces an unusual crisis when four of its best players - Sakuragi, Rukawa, Miyagi and Mitsui, are at risk of being disqualified from participating in the National Championship Games due to their poor academic grades, prompting Team Captain Akagi to beg the school authorities to give them a retry test and draft them into a study camp at his house.

Episodes.Title: Guys' Friendship? Sakuragi Gang
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi's gang take part-time jobs among two rivaling beachside stands to earn the money to pay for the travel expenses to watch the National Championship Games, and learn the hard lesson of hard-earned money when they unwittingly waste their first paycheck and then have to earn it back several times fold when asked by their employers to help defend their stands against a typhoon strike. Sakuragi steals their hard-earned money to pay for his travel expenses to attend Shohoku's friendship match with Jousei High but is dismayed to learn that he is being left behind at Coach Anzai's request, and the gang steal their money back from him.

Episodes.Title: Going Toward 20000 Shoots
Episodes.Description: Coach Anzai reveals that Sakuragi's weakness is long-distance shooting, so he puts him through a special training regime of 20,000 practice shots in a week to prepare for the National Championship Games. Haruko and Sakuragi's gang arrive to offer support.

Episodes.Title: Shizuoka's Fierce Fight! Shohoku vs. Jousei
Episodes.Description: While Sakuragi's training under Coach Anzai continues, the Shohoku Basketball Team faces off against the Jousei High Basketball Team in their friendship match.

Episodes.Title: Hanamichi's Hottest Day
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi's training is completed just as the Shohoku Basketball Team returns from their friendship match against Jousei High, and Haruko decides to reward Sakuragi for his hard practicing by taking him to the summer festival. Sakuragi sees this as an opportunity to try to get with her, but the process became harder than he had expected.

Episodes.Title: Basketball Shoes Part II
Episodes.Description: Sakuragi has been working hard for the past months to improve his basketball skills, but as a result, his shoes have torn. He visits none other than the man that gave him his first shoes.

Episodes.Title: Mixed Feelings, Uozumi Returns
Episodes.Description: When a couple of Shoyo players decided to give their goodlucks to Shohoku, Sakuragi comes up with a suggestion; a game against Shoyo and Ryonan!

Episodes.Title: Fierce Battle Begins! Shohoku vs. Shoyo/Ryonan
Episodes.Description: Rukawa garnered all the attention with his strong start to the game, but it was Sendoh who soon stole that spotlight when he entered the gym in his fishing clothes.

Episodes.Title: Facing the Strongest Team, Shohoku in Danger!
Episodes.Description: The combination team has become even more formidable by adding Sendoh and Fukuda to their lineup, and while Sakuragi is still struggling, Shohoku retains the lead.

Episodes.Title: The Man of Miracles, Hanamichi Sakuragi!
Episodes.Description: Fujima starts passing more and shooting less 3 pointers, giving hims teammates more open looks and easy opportunities to score. But is it enough to overcome Shohoku?

Episodes.Title: The Glorious Slam Dunk!
Episodes.Description: The game between Shoyo-Ryonan and Shohoku continues. At the last few minutes of the practice game, Sakuragi made two jump shots and everyone is amazed. The score is tied, when Fujima and Sendo attempts to do an alley-oop. Everyone is amazed when Sakuragi appeared at the back of Sendo, blocking the supposed alley-oop. Sakuragi then takes control of the ball and when he is about to dunk the ball, he remembered what Haruko taught him about slam dunk when he first met her. Shohoku wins with the score 76-74. The last episode ends showing the team of Shohoku and Kainan about to leave Kanagawa for the Inter High. When Shohoku is about to enter the shinkansen train, they promised to themselves that they're going to win the championship.

Episodes.Title: A Brush with Destiny
Episodes.Description: An artist's paintings come to life as monsters.

Episodes.Title: Passing the Lantern
Episodes.Description: A young boy inherits a magical lantern with dangerous powers.

Episodes.Title: Wizard for a Day
Episodes.Description: A young fan gains temporary wizard powers.

Episodes.Title: Fourth Down and Long
Episodes.Description: A sports-themed monster attacks Angel Grove's football game.

Episodes.Title: Stop the Hate Master (1)
Episodes.Description: A monster spreads hatred throughout Angel Grove.

Episodes.Title: Stop the Hate Master (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers combat the spread of hatred in Angel Grove.

Episodes.Title: Final Face-Off
Episodes.Description: The Rangers face Rito Revolto and Goldar in a major battle.

Episodes.Title: The Potion Notion
Episodes.Description: A potion-themed monster causes chaotic transformations.

Episodes.Title: A Ranger Catastrophe (1)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers are captured by a new enemy.

Episodes.Title: A Ranger Catastrophe (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers escape captivity to face their captor.

Episodes.Title: Changing of the Zords (1)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers receive new ninja-themed Zords.

Episodes.Title: Changing of the Zords (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers learn to control their new ninja Zords.

Episodes.Title: Changing of the Zords (3)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers battle with their full ninja Zord arsenal.

Episodes.Title: Follow That Cab!
Episodes.Description: A taxi-themed monster causes chaos in Angel Grove's streets.

Episodes.Title: A Different Shade of Pink (1)
Episodes.Description: Kimberly prepares to leave for the Pan Global Games.

Episodes.Title: A Different Shade of Pink (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers search for a new Pink Ranger.

Episodes.Title: A Different Shade of Pink (3)
Episodes.Description: Kat becomes the new Pink Ranger.

Episodes.Title: Rita's Pita
Episodes.Description: Rita Repulsa returns with a new scheme against the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Another Brick in the Wall
Episodes.Description: A construction-themed monster attacks Angel Grove.

Episodes.Title: A Chimp in Charge
Episodes.Description: A monkey monster causes chaos at Angel Grove Zoo.

Episodes.Title: Master Vile and the Metallic Armor (1)
Episodes.Description: Master Vile arrives with powerful new weapons.

Episodes.Title: Master Vile and the Metallic Armor (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers receive new metallic armor to combat Master Vile.

Episodes.Title: Master Vile and the Metallic Armor (3)
Episodes.Description: The final battle against Master Vile begins.

Episodes.Title: I'm Dreaming of a White Ranger
Episodes.Description: A holiday-themed episode with special surprises.

Episodes.Title: The Sound of Dischordia
Episodes.Description: A sound-based monster disrupts Angel Grove with noise attacks.

Episodes.Title: Rangers in Reverse
Episodes.Description: A time-manipulating monster reverses the Rangers' actions.

Quasar Quest (1)
Episodes.Description: Leo stows away aboard Terra Venture, joining a training mission where he meets Kendrix, Kai, and his brother Mike. After Maya arrives from planet Mirinoi seeking help against the villain Furio, the group travels through a portal to defend her world.

Episodes.Title: Quasar Quest (2)
Episodes.Description: Kai, Damon, and Alpha 6 revive the Astro Megaship to rescue the team on Mirinoi. Mike, Kendrix, Maya, Kai, and Damon claim the Quasar Sabers, becoming Power Rangers. Furio petrifies Mirinoi, and Mike sacrifices himself, passing his saber to Leo.

Episodes.Title: Race to the Rescue
Episodes.Description: Maya senses five captive Galactabeasts. The Rangers rescue them, gaining powerful allies to defend Terra Venture from Scorpius' monsters.

Episodes.Title: Rookie in Red
Episodes.Description: Leo joins Terra Venture's military but accidentally leaves a weapons vault unlocked, leading to a monster stealing the arsenal. He must reclaim the weapons to prove his worth.

Episodes.Title: Homesick
Episodes.Description: A stowaway boy tries to redirect Terra Venture back to Earth. Meanwhile, Furio launches an attack, forcing the Rangers to protect the colony.

Episodes.Title: The Lights of Orion
Episodes.Description: Furio sends a monster impersonating Mike to trick Leo into revealing the location of the Lights of Orion, a legendary power source.

Episodes.Title: Double Duty
Episodes.Description: Kendrix meets an actress who looks identical to her. When the actress feigns injury, Kendrix takes her place on a film set, only to battle a monster seeking the Lights of Orion.

Episodes.Title: The Blue Crush
Episodes.Description: Kai develops a crush on Commander Stanton's daughter while rollerblading, but romance takes a backseat when a monster attacks Terra Venture.

Episodes.Title: The Magna Defender
Episodes.Description: Leo battles Furio, who self-destructs after being defeated. Leo is saved by the mysterious Magna Defender, who emerges from a cave holding him.

Episodes.Title: The Sunflower Search
Episodes.Description: A monster believes the Lights of Orion are hidden in a sunflower statue. The Magna Defender reveals his tragic past and motive for vengeance against Scorpius.

Episodes.Title: Silent Sleep
Episodes.Description: A monster freezes Terra Venture's population to search for the Lights of Orion. Only Leo (protected by Mike's dog tags) and the Magna Defender remain unfrozen.

Episodes.Title: Orion Rising
Episodes.Description: Kendrix and Maya argue but must unite when a monster traps part of Terra Venture in a force field, seeking the Lights of Orion undisturbed.

Episodes.Title: Orion Returns
Episodes.Description: The Rangers, Scorpius, and Treacheron race to claim the Lights of Orion. The Scorpion Stinger damages the Astro Megaship, forcing the Rangers to pursue the Lights in Jet Jammers.

Episodes.Title: Shark Attack
Episodes.Description: Treacheron is framed as a traitor. Freed by the Shark brothers, he invades Terra Venture to capture Trakeena for revenge against Scorpius.

Episodes.Title: Redemption Day
Episodes.Description: The damaged Scorpion Stinger attempts to steal fuel from Terra Venture. The Magna Defender exploits this by destabilizing a volcano, endangering the colony for his vengeance.

Episodes.Title: Destined for Greatness
Episodes.Description: Skelecron captures four Rangers to power his warriors. Leo and Mike free them, with Mike embracing his destiny as the new Magna Defender to save the Galaxy Megazord.

Episodes.Title: Stolen Beauty
Episodes.Description: Trakeena sends a monster to steal beauty from Terra Venture's women. Disguised as a civilian, she tries to poison Mike, but he outwits her and reverses the theft.

Episodes.Title: The Rescue Mission
Episodes.Description: Mike leads a team to investigate a derelict ship, where a spider monster captures the crew. He and Leo free them, retrieving a mysterious book before the ship explodes.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Galactabeasts (1)
Episodes.Description: Deviot arrives with three powerful Zords (Stratoforce, Centaurus, Zenith) to attack Terra Venture. The Galactabeasts refuse to fight, forcing the Rangers to seek answers in the Galaxy Book.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Galactabeasts (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers decode the Galaxy Book to free the Galactabeasts from Deviot's control. They unite to defeat Deviot's Zords and protect Terra Venture.

Episodes.Title: Heir to the Throne
Episodes.Description: Trakeena escapes planet Onyx after Deviot orchestrates Scorpius' death. She assumes command of his army, preventing Deviot from using her transformation cocoon.

Episodes.Title: An Evil Game
Episodes.Description: Trakeena captures Leo to avenge her father. Their duel is interrupted when Deviot's assassins target Trakeena, allowing Leo to escape amid the chaos.

Episodes.Title: Memories of Mirinoi
Episodes.Description: Maya's friend Shondra appears on Terra Venture, but Kendrix suspects her. Maya discovers Shondra stealing the Galaxy Book, revealing her as one of Trakeena's monsters.

Episodes.Title: Green Courage
Episodes.Description: Trakeena takes High Commander Renier hostage, demanding a mechanic to fix the Scorpion Stinger. Damon volunteers, while Leo infiltrates the ship to rescue the Commander.

Episodes.Title: Blue to the Test
Episodes.Description: A monster mind-controls Commander Stanton into steering Terra Venture into a star. Kai disobeys orders to expose the plot and save the colony.

Episodes.Title: Mean Wheels Mantis
Episodes.Description: A motorcycle-riding monster kidnaps Maya and Kendrix. The Rangers race to rescue them, with Leo upgrading his bike to the Capsular Cycle to win.

Episodes.Title: Loyax's Last Battle
Episodes.Description: Trakeena sends the fallen hero Loyax to Terra Venture for a final battle. Maya convinces him to redeem himself, but Deviot destroys him.

Episodes.Title: A Red Romance
Episodes.Description: Leo pursues a romance with Hannah, whose overprotective brother complicates matters. When a monster abducts Hannah, Leo must save her and defeat the threat.

Episodes.Title: The Chameliac Warrior
Episodes.Description: Trakeena hires Chameliac, a warrior who copies opponents' fighting styles. The Rangers defeat him by unpredictably switching tactics.

Episodes.Title: To the Tenth Power
Episodes.Description: Deviot revives the Psycho Rangers. The Space Rangers arrive to help the Galaxy Rangers combat these deadly foes in a high-stakes battle.

Episodes.Title: The Power of Pink
Episodes.Description: Psycho Pink uses the Savage Sword against Cassie (Pink Space Ranger). Kendrix sacrifices herself to destroy the sword, dying in the process. Karone (Andros' sister) is chosen as the new Pink Ranger.

Episodes.Title: Protect the Quasar Saber
Episodes.Description: Karone, disguised as Astronema, steals the Pink Quasar Saber from an auction on Onyx. She delivers it to the Rangers, officially joining them as the new Pink Galaxy Ranger.

Episodes.Title: Facing the Past
Episodes.Description: Karone helps Leo regain his powers after the Magnetox monster drains them. Confronted by visions of her evil past as Astronema, she overcomes her guilt and obtains a key that restores Leo's abilities with enhanced armor.

Episodes.Title: Turn Up the Volume
Episodes.Description: Damon competes for chief mechanic against rival Baxter, who steals his plans. They must team up to defeat a monster attacking Terra Venture's systems.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Lost Galaxy
Episodes.Description: Deviot reads forbidden words from the Galaxy Book, transporting Terra Venture into the mysterious Lost Galaxy. The Rangers confront space pirates led by Captain Mutiny.

Episodes.Title: Beware the Mutiny
Episodes.Description: Captain Mutiny and Deviot enslave Terra Venture's citizens to mine for 'Earth.' The Rangers battle Mutiny's forces to free the colony.

Episodes.Title: Grunchor on the Loose
Episodes.Description: The colossal monster Grunchor burrows into Terra Venture. The Rangers must evacuate citizens and defeat it before it destroys the colony.

Episodes.Title: Until Sunset
Episodes.Description: Leo and Damon are captured by Deviot, reminiscing about past adventures. The other Rangers race to rescue them before Mutiny's deadline.

Episodes.Title: Dream Battle
Episodes.Description: Hexuba uses magic to trap the Rangers in nightmares. They must conquer their fears to wake up and save Terra Venture. (No stream link available)

Episodes.Title: Hexuba's Graveyard
Episodes.Description: Hexuba resurrects defeated monsters to attack the Rangers. The team fights their past foes in a climactic showdown.

Episodes.Title: Raise the Titanisaur
Episodes.Description: Captain Mutiny unleashes the Titanisaur, a gargantuan monster. The Rangers deploy all Zords in a desperate battle to protect Terra Venture.

Episodes.Title: Escape the Lost Galaxy
Episodes.Description: Mike sacrifices his Magna Defender powers to hold open a portal for Terra Venture's escape. Deviot betrays Mutiny and returns to Trakeena.

Episodes.Title: Journey's End (1)
Episodes.Description: Trakeena fuses with Deviot in Scorpius' cocoon, becoming a powerful insectoid monster. She cripples Terra Venture, forcing the evacuation to a nearby planet.

Episodes.Title: Journey's End (2)
Episodes.Description: Trakeena sets Terra Venture's wreckage on a collision course with a planet. The Rangers destroy her ship using the Astro Megaship's self-destruct, stranding Leo on a moon.

Episodes.Title: Journey's End (3)
Episodes.Description: Trakeena attacks Leo in Terra Venture's wreckage. Using his Battlizer armor, Leo defeats her but nearly dies. The Galactabeasts guide the colony to safety on Mirinoi, restoring its petrified people and reviving Kendrix.

Episodes.Title: Force from the Future (1)
Episodes.Description: In 3000 AD, mutant criminal Ransik escapes captivity, killing Red Ranger Alex Drake. Alex's team pursues him to 2001, where they recruit his ancestor Wes Collins to unlock their morphers.

Episodes.Title: Force from the Future (2)
Episodes.Description: Wes reluctantly uses Alex's morpher to help the Rangers battle Ransik. Though initially dismissed by Jen, he proves his worth during a mutant attack.

Episodes.Title: Something to Fight For
Episodes.Description: Wes questions his privileged life after Jen challenges his motivations. He earns the right to become the permanent Red Ranger by helping defeat a mutant attack.

Episodes.Title: Ransik Lives
Episodes.Description: Wes offers the Rangers shelter in his father's clock tower. During a painting job, Ransik takes Wes hostage and reveals the discrimination mutants face in the future.

Episodes.Title: A Blue Streak
Episodes.Description: Lucas must get a 2001 driver's license after being cited for speeding. A mutant challenges him to a high-speed chase during his driving test.

Episodes.Title: A Parting of Ways
Episodes.Description: Wes defies his father to rescue children held hostage by mutants. After publicly exposing his father's lack of charity, Wes moves into the clock tower.

Episodes.Title: Short-Circuited
Episodes.Description: Nadira kidnaps Circuit to prevent Megazord summoning. Trip must use his psychic powers against orders to locate their robotic ally during a mutant attack.

Episodes.Title: Jen's Revenge
Episodes.Description: Jen makes a dangerous deal with mutant Fat Catfish to locate Ransik, seeking personal vengeance for Alex's death.

Episodes.Title: The Time Shadow
Episodes.Description: When Bio-Lab's tank and the Megazord fail against a mutant, a mysterious ally from the future sends the Time Shadow zord.

Episodes.Title: Future Unknown
Episodes.Description: Ransik's actions alter the future, making Katie question their mission. Each Ranger must find personal motivation to stop Frax's new mutant.

Episodes.Title: Uniquely Trip
Episodes.Description: Trip loses confidence in his abilities and tries to imitate his teammates, learning to embrace his unique strengths instead.

Episodes.Title: Worlds Apart
Episodes.Description: Mr. Collins publicly shames Wes for working menial jobs. The Silver Guardians impress the Rangers during a Cyclobot attack, leading Eric to discover Wes is a Ranger.

Episodes.Title: The Quantum Quest
Episodes.Description: Ransik seeks the Quantum Controller uncovered by archaeologists. A rogue Silver Guardian activates it, becoming the Quantum Ranger.

Episodes.Title: Clash for Control (1)
Episodes.Description: Ransik sends Commandcom to steal the Quantum Rex zord. Eric refuses to surrender the Quantum Morpher and pursues the thief through time with Wes.

Episodes.Title: Clash for Control (2)
Episodes.Description: The Quantum Rex rampages through Silver Hills. Mr. Collins offers the Time Force Rangers positions in the Silver Guardians while Wes tries to reason with Eric.

Episodes.Title: Bodyguard in Blue
Episodes.Description: Dr. Zaskin is kidnapped by Nadira. His daughter Holly hires Lucas as a bodyguard, forcing him to reveal his Ranger identity while protecting her from mutants.

Episodes.Title: The Legend of the Clock Tower
Episodes.Description: Katie experiences a time-displaced adventure involving the clock tower's ghostly legend while the Rangers repair its mechanism.

Episodes.Title: Trust and Triumph
Episodes.Description: Jen's distrust of Wes allows Nadira to escape. Trapped in another dimension, they must learn teamwork to rescue their teammates.

Episodes.Title: Trip Takes a Stand
Episodes.Description: Trip befriends gentle mutant Notacon, who is forcibly weaponized by Frax. He must protect Notacon from Eric's destructive intentions.

Episodes.Title: Quantum Secrets
Episodes.Description: Eric is captured by mutant Conwing, who steals his morpher and controls the Q-Rex. Eric discovers the morpher's origin with help from the future.

Episodes.Title: Lovestruck Rangers
Episodes.Description: Male Rangers clash over attraction to Angelique. Jen discovers Angelique is a mutant controlling the team, forcing her and Katie to free them.

Episodes.Title: The Last Race
Episodes.Description: Nadira releases racer mutant Dash, who challenges Lucas to a high-stakes race. Dash plans to honor their agreement, but Nadira interferes.

Episodes.Title: Full Exposure
Episodes.Description: A tabloid photographer hires Katie to help photograph Rangers unmasked. She must warn the team while protecting their identities.

Episodes.Title: Movie Madness (1)
Episodes.Description: Ransik traps the Rangers in film genres. They battle movie-themed monsters while navigating classic cinema tropes.

Episodes.Title: Movie Madness (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers continue fighting through movie dimensions to escape Ransik's cinematic prison and return to reality.

Episodes.Title: Time Force Traitor
Episodes.Description: The Rangers suspect a traitor when Ransik anticipates their strategies. Internal distrust threatens to fracture the team.

Episodes.Title: Frax's Fury
Episodes.Description: Frax rebels against Ransik after constant humiliation. He creates powerful monsters to destroy both Ransik and the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Dawn of Destiny
Episodes.Description: Ransik forces Dr. Zaskin to create a cure for his mutation. The Rangers confront Ransik during his transformation crisis.

Episodes.Title: Fight Against Fate
Episodes.Description: Ransik learns of his future defeat. He attempts to change destiny by eliminating the Rangers before they can fulfill their roles.

Episodes.Title: Destiny Defeated
Episodes.Description: The Rangers seemingly defeat Ransik, altering the future. They face consequences for changing history while returning to 3000 AD.

Episodes.Title: Undercover Rangers
Episodes.Description: The Rangers go undercover at Silver Guardians headquarters to investigate suspicious activities, testing Eric's loyalty.

Episodes.Title: Beware the Knight
Episodes.Description: A medieval-themed mutant creates chaos. The Rangers must combat ancient weaponry while protecting historical reenactors.

Episodes.Title: Time for Lightspeed
Episodes.Description: The Time Force Rangers team up with the Lightspeed Rescue Rangers to combat a joint threat from Ransik and demon queen Olympius.

Episodes.Title: Reflections of Evil
Episodes.Description: A mirror-themed mutant creates evil duplicates of the Rangers. The team must confront their darker selves to prevail.

Episodes.Title: Nadira's Dream Date
Episodes.Description: Nadira kidnaps a celebrity for a dream date. The Rangers must rescue him while navigating her unpredictable powers.

Episodes.Title: Circuit Unsure
Episodes.Description: Circuit malfunctions during a critical battle, forcing Trip to repair him mid-fight while the Rangers face Ransik's new monster.

Episodes.Title: A Calm Before the Storm
Episodes.Description: Ransik prepares his final assault as the Rangers strengthen alliances. Tensions rise before the climactic battle.

Episodes.Title: The End of Time (1)
Episodes.Description: Ransik launches an all-out attack on Silver Hills. The Rangers make their final stand as the city descends into chaos.

Episodes.Title: The End of Time (2)
Episodes.Description: Ransik critically injures Jen. Wes and Eric pursue him through time as the remaining Rangers protect Silver Hills.

Episodes.Title: The End of Time (3)
Episodes.Description: Wes confronts Ransik in 3000 AD. Nadira's redemption and Ransik's surrender conclude the battle, with the Rangers choosing their futures.

Episodes.Title: Lionheart
Episodes.Description: Cole Evans joins four Power Rangers on the Animarium to battle Orgs after discovering his red lion crystal. The team forms the Wild Force Megazord for the first time.

Episodes.Title: Darkness Awakening
Episodes.Description: Master Org resurfaces as the Rangers learn to combine their Wild Zords into the Megazord. Cole attempts to reason with the heartless Orgs.

Episodes.Title: Click, Click, Zoom
Episodes.Description: Camera Org turns citizens invisible. Cole defies Taylor's leadership rules to rescue the team, leading to a reconciliation.

Episodes.Title: Never Give Up!
Episodes.Description: Max is captured by Bell Org after Danny neglects teamwork. Danny overcomes his fear of heights to rescue Max.

Episodes.Title: Ancient Awakening
Episodes.Description: Alyssa discovers an ancient emblem in a cave, leading to the summoning of the Elephant Zord to defeat Tire Org.

Episodes.Title: Wishes on the Water
Episodes.Description: Max tosses a wish into Turtle Cove lake, but Ship Org emerges with the bottle. The Giraffe Zord helps defeat the Org.

Episodes.Title: The Bear Necessities
Episodes.Description: Taylor discovers twin boys who transform into Bear Zords to help defeat Cell Phone Org and restore morphing abilities.

Episodes.Title: Soul Searching
Episodes.Description: Cole searches for the Soul Bird to heal the injured Red Lion Zord, encountering Master Org who recognizes Cole's family photo.

Episodes.Title: Soul Bird Salvation
Episodes.Description: Retinax freezes the Zords, but a hatched Soul Bird restores their powers, enabling the Rangers to defeat the Duke Org.

Episodes.Title: Curse of the Wolf
Episodes.Description: Nayzor releases Zen-Aku, who defeats the Rangers and steals the Elephant power orb using dark magic.

Episodes.Title: Battle of the Zords
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku summons Dark Wild Zords after saving Alyssa from Toxica and Jindrax, escalating the conflict.

Episodes.Title: Predazord, Awaken
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku combines Dark Zords into the Predazord, stealing the Giraffe Power Animal from the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Revenge of Zen-Aku
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku kidnaps Princess Shayla and frees Motorcycle Org. Shayla's necklace triggers his suppressed memories.

Episodes.Title: Identity Crisis
Episodes.Description: Nayzor manipulates Zen-Aku into believing he is pure evil, intensifying his attacks on the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: The Ancient Warrior
Episodes.Description: Animus reveals Zen-Aku's true identity as Merrick, an ancient warrior cursed by the Org mask.

Episodes.Title: The Lone Wolf
Episodes.Description: Merrick battles Quadra Org alone to retrieve stolen Animal Crystals, regaining his Lunar Wolf Ranger powers.

Episodes.Title: Power Play
Episodes.Description: Toxica becomes General Org Necronomica. Merrick helps defeat her using his Wolf Savage Cycle.

Episodes.Title: Secrets and Lies
Episodes.Description: Signal Org erases Cole's memory. Alyssa discovers Cole's parents are presumed dead.

Episodes.Title: The Tornado Spin
Episodes.Description: Max learns a bowling technique called the Tornado Spin to defeat Bowling Org, reviving his mentor's spirit.

Episodes.Title: Three's a Crowd
Episodes.Description: Danny competes for Kendall's affection while battling Wedding Dress Org, revealing his identity as the Black Ranger.

Episodes.Title: A Father's Footsteps
Episodes.Description: Alyssa uses her father's martial arts training to defeat Samurai Org and protect Turtle Cove.

Episodes.Title: Sing Song
Episodes.Description: Shayla and Merrick sing to awaken the Deer Zord, helping the Rangers defeat Tombstone Org.

Episodes.Title: The Wings of Animaria
Episodes.Description: Cole uses the Falcon Summoner to defeat the resurrected Nayzor, forming the Isis Megazord.

Episodes.Title: Reinforcements from the Future, Part 1
Episodes.Description: Time Force Rangers Wes and Eric arrive in Turtle Cove, teaming with Wild Force to battle Mut-Orgs.

Episodes.Title: Reinforcements from the Future, Part 2
Episodes.Description: Ransik destroys the Mut-Orgs' mutant halves, allowing 12 Rangers to defeat the hybrids in a joint battle.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Last Stand
Episodes.Description: Master Org kidnaps four Rangers and reveals his origin to Cole. Toxica and Jindrax find new leadership in Mandilok.

Episodes.Title: Unfinished Business
Episodes.Description: Zen-Aku returns to merge with Merrick, who must accept his friends' help to defeat his past darkness.

Episodes.Title: Homecoming
Episodes.Description: Cole befriends a boy named Kite, who helps defeat Mandilok's Duke Orgs Artilla and Helicos.

Episodes.Title: The Flute
Episodes.Description: Flute Org forces citizens to dance uncontrollably. Animus intervenes to save the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Team Carnival
Episodes.Description: Jindrax teams with his brother Juggelo to destroy the Rangers at an amusement park, leading to Juggelo's demise.

Episodes.Title: Taming of the Zords
Episodes.Description: Lion Tamer Org controls the Wild Zords. Kite frees them using mysterious powers.

Episodes.Title: Monitoring Earth
Episodes.Description: Mandilok turns Kite against humanity. Kite reveals himself as Animus and removes the Wild Zords.

Episodes.Title: The Soul of Humanity
Episodes.Description: The Rangers battle Toy Org without Zords. Animus restores their powers after witnessing human courage.

Episodes.Title: Forever Red
Episodes.Description: Cole teams with nine previous Red Rangers to stop the Machine Empire from reactivating Serpentera on the moon.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Herald, Part 1
Episodes.Description: Duke Org Onikage infiltrates the Animarium, kidnaps Princess Shayla, and creates Shadow Rangers.

Episodes.Title: The Master's Herald, Part 2
Episodes.Description: Onikage is destroyed by the Pegasus Megazord, but Master Org escapes with Princess Shayla.

Episodes.Title: Fishing for a Friend
Episodes.Description: Jindrax manipulates Rangers and Locomotive Org to re-energize Toxica's horn, reviving her from the spirit world.

Episodes.Title: Sealing the Nexus
Episodes.Description: Rangers battle resurrected Org Generals to disable the Nexus forcefield, enabling Toxica and Jindrax to rescue Shayla.

Episodes.Title: The End of the Power Rangers, Part 1
Episodes.Description: With villains seemingly defeated, the Rangers prepare to disband. Master Org returns as a new threat emerges.

Episodes.Title: The End of the Power Rangers, Part 2
Episodes.Description: Master Org's final assault forces the Rangers into a last battle for Earth and the Animarium.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Jungle (1)
Episodes.Description: Casey Rhodes, Lily Chilman, and Theo Martin are chosen as guardians of the imprisoned Dai Shi. When the arrogant Jarrod accidentally releases Dai Shi, the trio seeks their new master, RJ, at Jungle Karma Pizza.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Jungle (2)
Episodes.Description: The new Rangers adjust to their roles under RJ's guidance while battling Camille and Rinshi warriors flooding Ocean Bluff.

Episodes.Title: Sigh of the Tiger
Episodes.Description: Casey questions RJ's training methods while Buffalord attacks. Fran defends Jungle Karma Pizza from a chaotic birthday party.

Episodes.Title: A Taste of Poison
Episodes.Description: Dai Shi reveals himself in Jarrod's body and deploys the Five Fingers of Poison. Lily battles Rantipede after a nightmare about Jarrod.

Episodes.Title: Can't Win Them All
Episodes.Description: Theo's confidence shatters after losing to Gakko. RJ trains him to regain his skills while Casey and Lily protect the city alone.

Episodes.Title: Dance the Night Away
Episodes.Description: Tension between Theo and Casey escalates when Lily befriends Casey. Stingerella and Toady use dance rhythms to overpower the Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Pizza Slice of Life
Episodes.Description: RJ leaves Casey in charge of Jungle Karma Pizza, leading to chaos. Camille confronts Naja's plot to overthrow Dai Shi.

Episodes.Title: Way of the Master
Episodes.Description: Lily seeks the Jungle Mace from retired Master Phant to defeat Pangolin. Dai Shi prepares to resurrect the Sky Overlord.

Episodes.Title: Good Karma, Bad Karma
Episodes.Description: Casey's $5 tip is stolen by a boy named Josh. Carnisoar erases Jarrod's past good deeds to strengthen Dai Shi's control.

Episodes.Title: Blind Leading the Blind
Episodes.Description: Theo trains with blind Master Swoop to master Bat Spirit techniques. The Rangers battle Carnisoar's aerial warriors Bai Lai and Carden.

Episodes.Title: Pushed to the Edge
Episodes.Description: Camille seeks Lily's advice after Carnisoar's harsh training of Jarrod. She summons Sea Overlord Jellica, who trains Dai Shi instead.

Episodes.Title: One Master Too Many
Episodes.Description: RJ feels sidelined when Casey's second master, Shark technique expert Master Finn (RJ's father), arrives. Jellica unleashes Crustaceo.

Episodes.Title: Ghost of a Chance (1)
Episodes.Description: Overconfident Rangers are defeated by Dai Shi. RJ sacrifices himself to spare them, leaving them masterless.

Episodes.Title: Ghost of a Chance (2)
Episodes.Description: The Rangers enter the spirit world to rescue RJ and confront childhood fears. Fran discovers their secret identities.

Episodes.Title: Bad to the Bone
Episodes.Description: Lily's kindness backfires when Porcupongo's quill makes her rude. Fran helps her regain her true self.

Entries.Title: D.N.Angel
Entries.Description: During a funeral of a violinist, Daisuke is transported back in time by a magical violin. Dark has to bring Daisuke back to the present after witnessing Daiki as a phantom thief.

Episodes.Title: Dark Revived
Episodes.Description: It's Daisuke Niwa's 14th birthday and he's not having a good day. He tries to confesses his feelings to Risa Harada but finds out she only likes him as a friend. A student Satoshi Hiwatari oversees Daisuke using skills he's not supposed to have in order to unlock an electronic lock at school. When he challenges the training traps at his house, Daisuke transforms into the phantom thief Dark a black angel that has reside within the male members of the Niwa family for generations with the purpose of stealing cursed artworks. Daisuke learns he can't transform back into himself until he steals the Saint Tears statue tonight, and that becoming Dark is his destiny. As Dark escapes, he flies by the Harada mansion, and kisses Risa's older twin sister Riku Harada.

Episodes.Title: Rekindled Feelings
Episodes.Description: Riku is confused about her encounter with Dark and why she thought of Daisuke. Daisuke's family explain he has to find his "sacred maiden" if he wants to be free of Dark. Later at school, Daisuke agrees to go Dark-spotting with Risa, but due to his 'love condition' finds himself unable to show; instead, going to steal a bird artwork from a city landmark. Dark makes a bet with Daisuke in which Dark wins.

Episodes.Title: Whisper of the Unicorn
Episodes.Description: The city's young girls are being kidnapped—but by who? Daisuke and Dark have to find out, so they can save the Harada twins and steal an enchanted painting artwork of a girl and her Unicorn.

Episodes.Title: Between Light and Darkness
Episodes.Description: After Satoshi sets up an ambush for Daisuke, Dark has a minor battle with his 'other half' Krad a white devil who resides within the Hiwatari family.

Episodes.Title: Double Cooking
Episodes.Description: It is Daisuke's first cooking class and an unexpected visitor comes with him: Wiz - the Niwa's family pet; Dark's familiar. Risa (Riku in disguise) and Daisuke get an exciting detention of cabbage shredding, but can Daisuke break out in time for his next phantom thief mission? In the meantime, Wiz (disguise as Daisuke) says "I like you" to Riku.

Episodes.Title: St. White Memories
Episodes.Description: Daisuke wants to buy a present for his mother's birthday… but his wallet is more than a little empty. Emiko Niwa shares the story of how she met Kosuke with Daisuke while Dark is out to "Steal The Heart Of The World's Number One Lady".

Episodes.Title: Adonis Of the Promise Garden
Episodes.Description: Dark discovers the cursed statue of Adonis has been revived. Daisuke's grandfather, Daiki, reveals that he and Dark once tried to seal away Adonis long ago, but couldn't because a tsunami had swept it away along with its castle into the sea. Dark must stop the Adonis from preying on a schoolgirl's soul.

Episodes.Title: Menou's Warning Letter
Episodes.Description: Takeshi Saehara falls in love with a girl who has been bound to the Agate Links necklace for 40 years, given by Daiki. Daiki wants Daisuke to break the spell that is keeping her in the world. Daisuke gets hesitant until the end, when the girl sees his true form and thinks it's Daiki.

Episodes.Title: A Little Romance
Episodes.Description: Wiz discovers strawberries… and girls. Wiz falls head over heels of a lop eared bunny and Daisuke is blind of that love. When Wiz takes a strawberry to her, the shop was already closed. The next morning, Wiz's girlfriend was gone and Wiz ran all around the city looking for her. Daisuke and Riku have to ease the pain of a lost love. A storm brews up and as Daisuke changes into Dark. Dark says how its amusing for Daisuke trying to save Wiz, cause no matter how long they are apart, Wiz always comes back to Dark. Daisuke also realizes his crush on Riku.

Episodes.Title: The Portrait of a Certain Musician
Episodes.Description: During a funeral of a violinist, Daisuke is transported back in time by a magical violin. Dark has to bring Daisuke back to the present after witnessing Daiki as a phantom thief.

Episodes.Title: The Temple of Neptune
Episodes.Description: Dark must steal the Horn of Neptune from under the sea which is a big task. At the same time, Satoshi sets up his own plan to capture Dark; but unfortunately, Risa accidentally takes a stroll in middle of it.

Episodes.Title: Together With Rutile…
Episodes.Description: Kosuke returns home from his travels to a welcoming Emiko. Daisuke is a little embarrassed at meeting his father for the first time. Daisuke has to steal a famed rutile ring, but Satoshi doesn't make it easy. Krad makes another appearance, and this time, he isn't going to be defeated so easily.

Episodes.Title: The Eternal Mark
Episodes.Description: When Dark goes to steal The Eternal Guide statue, a 'sealer' placed by Satoshi causes Dark, Risa and Takeshi's souls to be trapped inside a stone. To rescue them, Daisuke has to travel into what appears to be the future with Towa. While there, he stumbles upon someone special.

Episodes.Title: A New Rival
Episodes.Description: Towa moves in the Niwa household as a maid. A new student, Mio Hio, arrives in Daisuke's class. She turns out to be a little more than the class bargained for and on top of that, holds a deadly secret. Satoshi saves Daisuke in swimming class by performing CPR on him. Dark takes Risa on a date, which makes Daisuke depress in the end.

Episodes.Title: Barbecue Panic
Episodes.Description: It's school holidays. The Harada's limo breaks down on the way to activities—in front of Daisuke's house. Miss Hio also happens to be passing through the neighborhood. After a shopping spree, Emiko and Towa return and the lively Niwa household hosts a Barbecue.

Episodes.Title: I Found It
Episodes.Description: Riku revisits her childhood memories after finding an old teddy-bear in her closet that was given to her by her grandmother, Rika. Dark goes to steal an artwork from the "haunted" Old Clover Mansion… which is where Riku lost the teddy-bear when she was younger, that it was later rescued by a boy. Risa also discovers a secret close to Dark's heart after Dark says she won't see him anymore. Riku figured out later that it is Daisuke who retrieved her precious thing, the teddy bear.

Episodes.Title: A Summer Without Dark
Episodes.Description: Daisuke's class goes on an excursion to a tropical island to watch the Milky Way. Takeshi is rather into Mio. Both Risa and Riku are increasingly attracted to Daisuke and a nature hike will determine which twin will end up with Daisuke.

Episodes.Title: The Two Under The Shooting Stars
Episodes.Description: Riku sprains her ankle after a fall and Daisuke carries her. Mio is playing psychic. Risa suspects Daisuke of being Dark, but decides he's not when she realizes he doesn't act like Dark, becoming more mature. Daisuke finally realizes his true feelings for Riku after clearing a misunderstanding, and the two watch beautiful shooting stars falling near the beach.

Episodes.Title: Beautiful Heroine
Episodes.Description: Daisuke has to create an artwork for the cultural festival. Satoshi discovers his father's, Kei Hiwatari, scheme to capture Dark. Risa uncovers secrets of the love between Dark and her grandmother Rika, in a letter hidden at the Harada mansion. Meanwhile, the boys in Daisuke's class are to be performing the play "Ice and Snow", with Daisuke and Satoshi filling the lead roles.

Episodes.Title: Because I Wanted To See You
Episodes.Description: Kosuke enlightens Daisuke with the story of "Ice and Snow". Daisuke completes his piece for the festival - a painting of a snowscape, where the shadows on the purest snow are blue instead of gray. Mio must make a very important decision. As Riku gives Daisuke the pendant of friendship instead of love, Mio sacrifices herself in the end.

Episodes.Title: An Icy Voice Calling
Episodes.Description: Daisuke is feeling ill. Satoshi warns Daisuke that something is up, then Kosuke has a friendly chat with Satoshi. At nightfall, Daisuke enters the world of his painting, led by an entity known as "The Second Hand of Time". Dark has to steal the painting left at the Harada's household in order to bring Daisuke back.

Episodes.Title: Ice and Snow
Episodes.Description: Dark enters the snowscape world of the painting with both of the Harada twins in order to search and rescue Daisuke.

Episodes.Title: The Second Hand of Time
Episodes.Description: Kosuke discovers the original edition of the story, entitled "Ice and Dark". Meanwhile, Daisuke meets a girl named Freedert who is one with the Second Hand of Time, waiting for her long lost lover - Elliott. Long ago, the two lovers were cursed due to a childhood friend's jealous. Dark goes in search of "The Wedge of Time" sword, a Hiwatari's family artwork which is the key to rescuing Daisuke and bringing the story to an end.

Episodes.Title: Snow Falls in The Heart
Episodes.Description: Dark battles Krad to retrieve the Wedge of Time as the Harada twins witness it all. Satoshi repaints Daisuke's painting to retrieve him. Freedert and Elliott are finally reunited. The story of Ice and Dark is completed as snow comes falling down upon the city.

Episodes.Title: The Black Wings
Episodes.Description: Once Christmas is approaching, the signs of a 40-year repeated disaster—an extreme low tide and an earthquake—prompt the city authorities to issue an evacuation. Riku worries about Daisuke and she eventually finds out about his and Dark's identity.

Episodes.Title: Eternal Dark
Episodes.Description: Once upon a time the Hiwatari family created a living artwork, known as The Black Wings. The Niwa family, a family of phantom thieves tried to steal the artwork. The artwork must now be sealed forever. Krad and Dark fight, and at the end they both are sealed into the Black Wings, from which they came from. The Harada twins help Mio to stop Kei. After Daisuke saves Satoshi from sacrificing his life, Daisuke clearly realize Riku is his sacred maiden and the two kiss, and Dark and Krad disappear peacefully.

Entries.Title: Prehistoric Park
Entries.Description: Nigel journeys to the Late Cretaceous (75 million years ago) to capture Deinosuchus, a 9-ton crocodilian relative of alligators. The mission is perilous, with concerns that Nigel 'may have bitten off more than he can chew.' The creature is housed in 'Deinosuchus Dip' [citation:2][citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: T-Rex Returns
Episodes.Description: Nigel ventures to Late Cretaceous Montana (65 million years ago) to rescue a Tyrannosaurus rex. After encountering a Triceratops (named Theo) and witnessing a T. rex battle, he saves two juvenile T. rex (Terence and Matilda) moments before the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs [citation:5][citation:6][citation:9].

Episodes.Title: A Mammoth Undertaking
Episodes.Description: Nigel travels to Siberia 10,000 years ago to rescue a woolly mammoth named Martha from extinction. He faces challenges including a cave bear and injured mammoths, while in the park, Martha is introduced to a herd of African elephants in the specialized 'Mammoth Mount' enclosure [citation:6][citation:9][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: DinoBirds
Episodes.Description: Nigel visits Cretaceous China (125 million years ago) to rescue Microraptors – feathered dinosaurs that support the theory that birds evolved from dinosaurs. This urgent mission occurs just before a volcanic eruption wipes out the local fauna [citation:2][citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: Saving the Sabre Tooth
Episodes.Description: Nigel and big cat specialist Saba Douglas-Hamilton travel to South America 1 million years ago to rescue the giant saber-toothed cat Smilodon. Nigel speculates that overspecialization contributed to their extinction. The rescued cats are housed in the 'Big Cat Climb' enclosure [citation:2][citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: The Bug House
Episodes.Description: Nigel travels to the Upper Carboniferous period (300 million years ago) to rescue giant arthropods including Meganeura (giant dragonfly), Arthropleura (giant millipede), and Pulmonoscorpius (giant scorpion). These creatures are housed in a specialized high-oxygen enclosure called 'The Bug House' [citation:6][citation:10].

Episodes.Title: Giant Croc
Episodes.Description: Nigel journeys to the Late Cretaceous (75 million years ago) to capture Deinosuchus, a 9-ton crocodilian relative of alligators. The mission is perilous, with concerns that Nigel 'may have bitten off more than he can chew.' The creature is housed in 'Deinosuchus Dip' [citation:2][citation:6][citation:10].

Entries.Description: Seung Don posts a disciplinary notice against Gang Ju on the company network, escalating their father-son conflict.

Episodes.Title: Fateful Reunion
Episodes.Description: Da Rim learns she'll go blind without an $800,000 treatment. She reunites with Gang Ju, her wealthy college classmate, who becomes unexpectedly involved in her life.

Episodes.Title: Burdened Secrets
Episodes.Description: Da Rim hides her diagnosis from family while hoping to win lottery money. Gang Ju reappears in her life as fate intertwines their paths again.

Episodes.Title: Accidental Connection
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju and Da Rim quarrel, leading to an accident that forces them together. Tae Ung grows suspicious of Gang Ju's intentions.

Episodes.Title: Mountain Discovery
Episodes.Description: Man Deuk and Gil Rye get lost on Mount Euak and witness Gil Soon burying a mysterious bag, potentially containing life-changing wealth.

Episodes.Title: Family Tensions
Episodes.Description: The family argues over Da Rim's treatment costs. Da Rim drinks alone, unable to pay, while Gang Ju unexpectedly comes to her aid.

Episodes.Title: Funeral Revelation
Episodes.Description: Man Deuk and Gil Rye attend Gil Sun's funeral, realizing the money-burying man has died. They plan to retrieve the hidden fortune.

Episodes.Title: Midnight Expedition
Episodes.Description: Man Deuk and Gil Rye secretly return to Mount Euak to retrieve the buried money, unaware they're being watched by Bong Hui.

Episodes.Title: Hope and Disaster
Episodes.Description: Da Rim schedules her surgery while Gang Ju causes a major accident at the laundry, creating new complications for everyone.

Episodes.Title: Missing Millions
Episodes.Description: Ji Yeon pressures Seung Don about missing money while Da Rim joyfully regains her sight, unaware of the stolen funds' origins.

Episodes.Title: Growing Attraction
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju can't stop thinking about Da Rim and visits the laundry's reopening. Da Rim struggles with job hunting while adjusting to regained vision.

Episodes.Title: Biological Truth
Episodes.Description: Seung Don confirms Tae Ung is his biological son but coldly states nothing will change, sparking fury in Tae Ung.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Confessions
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju gets drunk after learning Tae Ung is Seung Don's biological son, leading to a fistfight and emotional revelations about his feelings for Da Rim.

Episodes.Title: Money Trail
Episodes.Description: Ji Yeon tracks stolen money to Mu Rim's wedding venue while Tae Ung demands Gang Ju withdraw Da Rim's job offer.

Episodes.Title: Wedding Windfall
Episodes.Description: Mu Rim unknowingly uses stolen wedding cash to repay Da Rim's surgery debt while Ji Yeon investigates the money's origin.

Episodes.Title: Family Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Ji Yeon and Bong Hui slap Seung Don after learning about Tae Ung while Gang Ju faces trouble over a mysterious package.

Episodes.Title: Mother and Son
Episodes.Description: Tae Ung meets his birth mother Ae Ri in New York while Seung Don grows furious about Gang Ju attending film school.

Episodes.Title: Digital Discovery
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju traces an inflammatory post's IP address while Man Deuk searches for a ledger that could expose the stolen money.

Episodes.Title: CCTV Evidence
Episodes.Description: Seong Hun shows Gang Ju dry cleaner CCTV footage of the stolen money, unaware Seung Don sees them together.

Episodes.Title: Father's Favoritism
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju feels hurt as Seung Don favors Tae Ung. Da Rim confesses her feelings to Tae Ung again, complicating relationships.

Episodes.Title: Money Hunt
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju sneaks into Man Deuk and Gil Rye's room after overhearing the truth about the stolen money at the laundry.

Episodes.Title: Hidden Fortune
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju discovers the stolen money in Bong Hui's house while the family is distracted at Mi Ok's dinner party.

Episodes.Title: Confession Attempt
Episodes.Description: Da Rim tries confessing to Ji Yeon about the stolen money, but Gang Ju intervenes, protecting her from consequences.

Episodes.Title: Family Crisis
Episodes.Description: Man Deuk collapses and is hospitalized, leaving Da Rim distraught. Gang Ju comforts her as Ji Yeon arranges a secret meeting.

Episodes.Title: Business Clash
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju and Da Rim argue as business partners while suspicious messages appear from Gil Soon's supposedly dead phone.

Episodes.Title: Rooftop Showdown
Episodes.Description: Tae Ung tries evicting Gang Ju from the rooftop unit, but Da Rim defends him as Mi Ok investigates the stolen money.

Episodes.Title: Family Explosion
Episodes.Description: Ji Yeon storms into Seung Don and Tae Ung's shared home after learning they live together, demanding they separate immediately.

Episodes.Title: Mother's Arrest
Episodes.Description: Mu Rim handcuffs his mother Bong Hee and drives to the police station, making her confront the severity of her crimes.

Episodes.Title: Delirious Truths
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju and Da Rim desperately search for a designer while Gil Rye shows signs of delirium, accidentally confessing family secrets.

Episodes.Title: Disciplinary Action
Episodes.Description: Seung Don posts a disciplinary notice against Gang Ju on the company network, escalating their father-son conflict.

Episodes.Title: Stolen Glances
Episodes.Description: Gang Ju and Da Rim share meaningful looks as tensions rise over the stolen money and their complicated relationships.

Episodes.Title: Birthday Surprise
Episodes.Description: Da Rim plans a surprise birthday for Gang Ju while Tae Ung conspires with Ae Ri to remove Gang Ju from the company.

Episodes.Title: Company Coup

Episodes.Title: Secret Ledger

Episodes.Title: The Curtain Rises

Entries.Title: Bleach
Entries.Description: When Renji asks Szayelaporro how he negated his bankai, Szayelaporro reveals that he gathered the data using parasites stored in the body of his older brother Ilfort Grantz, who Renji fought and defeated. With only his shikai, Renji's attacks cannot harm Szayelaporro. Meanwhile, Ulquiorra meets Ichigo to inform him of Rukia's death. Ichigo attempts to leave to save Rukia, but Ulquiorra goads him into fighting by revealing that he was the person who forced Orihime to come to Hueco Mundo. Furious, Ichigo uses his bankai, dons his hollow mask and prepares to fight Ulquiorra in anger.

Episodes.Title: The Day I Became a Shinigami
Episodes.Description: Ichigo Kurosaki is a fifteen-year-old high school student with orange hair, brown eyes, and the ability to see spirits. As he tries to protect the spirit of a little girl from a hollow, he witnesses a clash between the malevolent spirit and a female Soul Reaper. Later, Ichigo is met by the same woman again in his room. She introduces herself as Rukia Kuchiki, and explains to Ichigo the basic duty of the Soul Reapers is the act of soul cleansing. The hollow, named Fishbone D, returns to absorb Ichigo's high spiritual energy, attacking Ichigo's home, and Rukia is wounded. In order to save his family, Ichigo desperately takes Rukia’s power into himself and becomes a Soul Reaper to successfully defeat the hollow.

Episodes.Title: A Shinigami's Work
Episodes.Description: After discovering Rukia has enrolled in his class, Ichigo learns that she has lost her power and that he must pose as her substitute, until her powers can recover. Although he refuses this responsibility at first, Ichigo eventually accepts after realizing he cannot just turn a blind eye if he encounters a hollow again.

Episodes.Title: The Older Brother's Wish, the Younger Sister's Wish
Episodes.Description: Ichigo discovers that one of his schoolmates, Orihime Inoue, is being stalked by her older brother's spirit who turned into the hollow Acidwire due to Orihime stopping her prayers for him, which makes him hesitate to fulfill his duty. As Ichigo is forced to use his power again, his qualms of killing hollows are rested and he finally submits to his purpose as a substitute Soul Reaper, killing Acidwire. Before he does so however, Orihime's older brother was able to revert to his kind and gentle nature, expressing his love for her and thanking her before being sent to the Soul Society, the place where Soul Reapers and souls reside, via Ichigo's zanpakuto.

Episodes.Title: Cursed Parakeet
Episodes.Description: Ichigo’s friend Yasutora "Chad" Sado comes into possession of a cursed cockatiel that is inhabited by the soul of a small boy, Yui'ichi Shibata, but supposed misfortune to anyone who possesses the cockatiel is due to a hollow named Shrieker who has been stalking the boy's soul. Chad is attacked by Shrieker before Rukia arrives to aid him.

Episodes.Title: Beat the Invisible Enemy!
Episodes.Description: With Rukia's help, Chad fights Shrieker despite not being able to see him. Ichigo eventually arrives and defeats the Shrieker. But as Shrieker was originally a murderer in life, he is dragged through the Gates of Hell instead of dissolving into the Soul Society. The spirit that inhabited the cockatiel is released to move on to the Soul Society.

Episodes.Title: Fight to the Death! Ichigo vs. Ichigo
Episodes.Description: In order for Ichigo to transform into a Soul Reaper when Rukia is not around, she purchases some soul candy from the Urahara Shop for him. However, the candy is actually a modsoul, an artificial warrior from the Soul Society created to destroy hollows. Once inside Ichigo's body, the modsoul goes on a rampage while ruining Ichigo's social image and turning pevert.

Episodes.Title: Greetings from a Stuffed Lion
Episodes.Description: Ichigo confronts the mad modsoul possessing his body, but is then distracted by an emerging hollow. Together, they defeat the hollow. When Kisuke Urahara, the merchant who sold Rukia her gigai, comes for the "defective" merchandise, Ichigo takes the modsoul back and places him into a stuffed lion plushie while naming him "Kon" to get even with him wounding his shoulder. Meanwhile in the Soul Society, a Soul Reaper is sent to track down Rukia for retrieval.

Episodes.Title: June 17, Memories in the Rain
Episodes.Description: Ichigo and his family visit their mother's grave on the anniversary of her death. While there, the Soul Reaper sent to retrieve Rukia attacks them because she broke the Soul Society's laws by giving Ichigo her powers. The battle halts when Ichigo's sisters Karin and Yuzu are attacked by a huge hollow.

Episodes.Title: Unbeatable Enemy
Episodes.Description: Ichigo confronts the hollow, who is revealed as the Grand Fisher, the hollow who killed Ichigo's mother. In a fit of rage, Ichigo defeats the hollow as he escapes before he is killed. The Soul Reaper sent after Rukia leaves with a warning when he witnesses Ichigo's strength.

Episodes.Title: Assault on Trip at Sacred Ground!
Episodes.Description: When popular TV star/spirit medium Don Kanonji transforms a spirit into a hollow during an exorcism, Ichigo is forced to clean up the mess. Upon the hollow's defeat, Kanonji is shocked to realize what he has done. With a little cheering-up from Ichigo, Kanonji is back to his old self again, and calls Ichigo, despite Ichigo's objections, his new apprentice.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Quincy
Episodes.Description: While on another hollow fighting mission, Ichigo encounters Uryū Ishida, a classmate belonging to a clan known as the Quincy, humans that can use spiritual power to manifest a bow to fight hollows. Uryū declares himself an enemy of all Soul Reapers and challenges Ichigo to a competition of hunting hollows.

Episodes.Title: A Gentle Right Arm
Episodes.Description: The contest between Ichigo and Uryū has lured hundreds of hollows into Karakura Town, endangering many of Ichigo's friends. Chad is forced to fight a hollow in order to save Karin. During the battle, he finally can see the hollow clearly, and develops a new ability, an armored right arm capable of firing energy blasts called "The Right Arm of the Giant".

Episodes.Title: Flower and Hollow
Episodes.Description: The situation worsens as more hollows appear in the human world, attacking the school where Orihime and her friends are. While defending them, Orihime develops her own power, the Shun Shun Rikka, a group of fairy-like creatures coming from the hairpins given to her by her brother, and defeats the hollow. Afterward, Urahara takes in Orihime and Chad to help them with their new powers while Rukia and Ichigo confront Uryū.

Episodes.Title: Back to Back, a Fight to the Death!
Episodes.Description: The legion of hollows force Ichigo and Uryū to team up in combat while the others watch. A giant hollow called a Menos Grande arrives on the scene, and is driven away after Ichigo inflicts a wound assisted by power from Uryū. However, he releases too much spiritual power in the process. The strain of his powers causes Ichigo to lose consciousness, and Uryū saves him by releasing the excess energy through his bow.

Episodes.Title: Kon's Great Plan
Episodes.Description: Tired of mistreatment from Ichigo, Kon runs away to find a better owner, but he finds his abuse continuing from girls due to his perverse nature.
